radiology_report: Prostate volume: 62.18 cc. PSA density: 0.198 ng/mL/cc. PI-RADS: 5.
pathology_report: The patient underwent 2 biopsy sessions. At the first session, Gleason 3+3 (ISUP grade group 1) was identified in the right peripheral zone (mid-apex); perineural invasion was present, with no cribriform pattern or intraductal carcinoma. 12.9 months later, at the second session, Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2) was identified in the right peripheral zone (mid); no cribriform pattern or intraductal carcinoma were identified. The reported histological growth pattern was: Acinar; Adenocarcinoma.
surgical_pathology_report: The robot-assisted radical prostatectomy specimen showed Gleason 3+4 (ISUP grade group 2), pathological stage pT2. There was no extraprostatic extension; surgical margins were positive; the seminal vesicles were not invaded; lymphovascular invasion was absent; no lymph nodes were removed.
family_history: Family history of prostate or breast cancer is unknown.
